svg.title: How a task finds its model
svg.desc: An example: a review task marked private. omnitrix first removes accounts that cannot take it: Kimi is cooling down and Mistral may train on prompts. It scores the rest on skill fit, quota left, cost and past results. DeepSeek scores highest and gets the task; if that call fails, GLM and then Codex take over.
